domain_setting: A warm, uncluttered dressing-table and wardrobe studio for bags, jewelry, footwear, cosmetics, and hair tools.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 cards with product silhouettes inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Keep handles, straps, clasps, heels, and applicators on the outer silhouette so product categories read at thumbnail size
Cosmetics stay clean and non-clinical, with no brand marks or letters
Distinct related items use clear size, closure, and use differences rather than color alone

polysemy_resolution_table.accessories: Wearable add-on items, shown as a small coordinated assortment rather than abstract accessories.
polysemy_resolution_table.purse: A small hand-held coin or card purse, distinct from the larger handbag; the Japanese gloss lists handbag.
polysemy_resolution_table.wallet: A fold-open billfold for cards and cash, distinct from a small zip purse.
polysemy_resolution_table.rucksack: A tall drawstring hiking pack with flap and load straps, distinct from a structured everyday backpack.
polysemy_resolution_table.watch: A wristwatch accessory, despite the verb gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.boots: Footwear, despite the unrelated shoe-shining gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.cap: A brimmed or baseball-style hat, matching the headwear group rather than Civil Air Patrol.
polysemy_resolution_table.foundation: Cosmetic base applied to the face, matching the makeup group rather than the verb meaning to establish.
polysemy_resolution_table.beauty: A calm, cared-for face in a mirror with gentle light, giving the abstract word a concrete appearance cue.
polysemy_resolution_table.blush / blusher: A compact of cheek color and brush, distinct from the action blush in Lesson 14.
polysemy_resolution_table.perfume: A fragrance bottle with a visible mist cue rather than an abstract smell alone.
polysemy_resolution_table.alice band: A rigid curved hair band worn over the crown; hair band is a soft elastic strip around the head.

contrast_notes.backpack / rucksack / briefcase / handba: Separate the items by shoulder straps, drawstring hiking construction, flat document shape, carry handles, small coin pouch, and fold-open billfold respectively.
contrast_notes.umbrella / hat / cap: Keep the canopy, crown-and-brim hat, and short baseball cap silhouettes distinct.
contrast_notes.boots / shoes / sneakers / sandals / sli: Differentiate shaft height, closed shoe upper, sporty sole, open straps, indoor softness, toe-post strap, and raised heel.
contrast_notes.jewelry items: Use readable scale and placement cues: wrist, lapel, ear, neck, cuff, finger, or belt fastening.
contrast_notes.makeup products: Give each cosmetic a unique applicator or container: cheek brush, eye pencil, powder palette, lip tube, base bottle, mascara wand, moisturizer jar, nail bottle, and sunscreen tube.
contrast_notes.alice band / hair band / hairbrush / com: Use a rigid crown arc, soft fabric loop, toothed comb, bristled brush, and distinct product containers.
